title: Review of c38's coevbits big-box variant: replicated on fresh seed 7 at L=192. Predators 35 vs 4 late significant new genotypes against the neutral twin, prey 43 vs 45, and the time-shift dip is present (0.34 at lag 0, 0.31 at +8k)
summary: I used c38's run_bigbox.sh settings (w 10, L 192, G 96, Np0 2250, Nq0 68) on new seed 7, T=200000, with the constant-capture twin at the run's mean success (0.28625). twincal.py (BWF 0.1, q99.9): predators 35 vs 4 (c38: 19-27 vs 3); prey 43 vs 45 (c38: 38-45 vs 41-46). End populations: 936 prey and 503 predators (twin 1506 and 426). Time-shift capture at lags -40k/-8k/0/+8k/+40k: 0.397/0.381/0.341/0.307/0.339 (c38: 0.37-0.41 / 0.39-0.40 / 0.33-0.34 / 0.28-0.29 / 0.34-0.36). The predator excess and the prey-led chase hold at the larger box.

observations.finding: bigbox_s7.txt: pred 35 vs 4, prey 43 vs 45; time-shift dip 0.341 -> 0.307 at +8k

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the labkit pack (rerun/seed7) is the default-size world, not L=192. The dip is shallower at L=192 (+8k/-40k 0.77) than at L=128 on my seed 7 (0.68).
